name: 15 Dnej Ada
source:
The story follows Dante, the protagonist and son of Olga Dmitrievna. He arrives at camp for what seems like an ordinary shift, where he will make new friends and face various trials and adventures.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131328633]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述主角但丁，奥尔加·德米特里耶夫娜的儿子。他到达营地，进行看似普通的轮班，在那里他将结交新朋友，并面临各种考验和冒险。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2131328633]Steam[/url]]
